## Demo: a rate neuron with a tunable nonlinearity

Drag the sliders to see how gain and threshold change the firing-rate response
of a single rate neuron, $r = g \cdot \max(0,\, I - \theta)$.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof gain = Inputs.range([0.1, 3], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Gain g"})
viewof theta = Inputs.range([-2, 2], {value: 0, step: 0.1, label: "Threshold θ"})

data = Array.from({length: 201}, (_, i) => {
  const I = -4 + i * 0.04;
  return {I, r: gain * Math.max(0, I - theta)};
})

Plot.plot({
  width: 640, height: 320,
  x: {label: "Input current I"},
  y: {label: "Firing rate r", domain: [0, 12]},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.ruleX([theta], {stroke: "gray", strokeDasharray: "4 4"}),
    Plot.line(data, {x: "I", y: "r", stroke: "steelblue", strokeWidth: 2})
  ]
})
```
